start.text: A path in the cinder, a little paler than the rest, a foot wide, going round the Spire's foot at the same distance all the way, and back to where it started.
One pair of feet made it, walking round and round. Not lately and not long ago: the cinder doesn't keep a day.
A woman goes about higher up, Ness said. Doesn't sit at all.
She's on it now, somewhere round the far side. You can hear her coming.
Nobody's walking it now. She sits by it on an edge-stone, facing the door.
You don't walk on it. It isn't yours.
